filter-bar.label: Packet Filter
filter-bar.description: Type a filter expression to show only matching packets. Supports fields like proto, src, dst, port, and len with operators ==, !=, >, <. Combine with AND / OR / NOT. Example: proto == TCP AND port == 443

interface-selector.label: Network Interface
interface-selector.description: Choose which network adapter to capture traffic from. Green dot means the interface is currently active. Disabled during an active capture session.

buffer-capacity.label: Buffer Capacity
buffer-capacity.description: Maximum number of packets held in memory at once. When the buffer is full, the oldest packet is dropped to make room for the newest. Range: 1,000 – 100,000 packets. Default: 10,000.

simulated-speed.label: Replay Speed
simulated-speed.description: Controls how fast a PCAP file is replayed in Simulated mode. 1× plays at the original capture speed. 0.5× is half speed (easier to follow); 5× is five times faster. Inter-packet delays are capped at 2 seconds.

theme-toggle.label: Color Theme
theme-toggle.description: Switch between light and dark mode. By default, NetVis follows your operating system's color scheme preference.

start-capture.label: Start Capture
start-capture.description: Begin capturing live packets on the selected network interface. Requires an interface to be selected first. On Linux, the binary needs cap_net_raw capability; on Windows, Npcap must be installed.

stop-capture.label: Stop Capture
stop-capture.description: Stop the active capture session. Packets already in the buffer are retained until you clear the buffer or start a new session.

simulated-capture.label: Simulated Capture
simulated-capture.description: Load a PCAP file and replay its packets into the buffer at a configurable speed. Useful in environments where live network capture is unavailable or restricted.

export-pcap.label: Export PCAP
export-pcap.description: Save all packets currently in the buffer to a .pcap file. The file can be opened in Wireshark or other packet analysis tools.

import-pcap.label: Import PCAP
import-pcap.description: Load a .pcap or .pcapng file into the buffer for offline analysis. Files up to 100 MB are supported.

reduced-motion.label: Reduce Motion
reduced-motion.description: Disable all animations and transitions in the interface. Useful if you find motion distracting or if you have a vestibular disorder. This setting overrides the operating system preference.

open-log-folder.label: Open Log Folder
open-log-folder.description: Opens the folder containing NetVis diagnostic log files in your system file explorer. Logs are useful for troubleshooting capture errors or reporting bugs.
